answer: A garden peer-audit bond blocks bulk fake identities. Each identity takes a garden plot by a lagoon, locks a 60-credit bond, and files a key-signed signal per epoch: lagoon level, harvest. A beacon audits one plot in eight; three peers re-measure the signal. A 5% miss, a reused serial, or a rented-plot ring filing burns the bond. First filing 43, kth 43+3(k-1); 1,000 fakes: 1,541,500 plus 60,000 locked. Honest gardeners pay 43 once and keep it.
